name: Ban on the Language in Books and Public Speeches (1892–1905) (C0049)

techniques.comment: Total censorship of translations and book imports: in 1892 the Main Administration for Press Affairs directed the censorship committee to suppress translations into Ukrainian, "reducing the number of such talentless works for purely state purposes"(Citation: Об отмене стеснений малорусского печатного слова 1905); "The ban on importing Ukrainian books from abroad was confirmed in the harshest form in 1894"(Citation: Навічно кували кайдани 1995).

The destruction of the basis for teaching children in their native language: "By a special circular of the Main Administration for Press Affairs in 1895, the printing of any books or collections in the Ukrainian language for children's reading was forbidden, 'even if in the substance of their content they appeared well-intentioned.'" The censor's resolution on a children's collection: "Obviously written for children, but they must learn in Russian. — Forbid"(Citation: Навічно кували кайдани 1995).
